    print\(f''\\n{chr\(61\) * 70}''\)

        mask = y_true_img >= 0
        y_true_img, y_pred_img = y_true_img[mask], y_pred_img[mask]

            m = y_t >= 0

            case_pred.append\(int\(vote\)\)

        # Case-level confusion matrix

        cm_case = confusion_matrix\(case_true, case_pred\)
        print\(f''    TN={cm_case[0,0]}, FP={cm_case[0,1]}, FN={cm_case[1,0]}, TP={cm_case[1,1]}''\)
        sens_case = cm_case[1,1]/\(cm_case[1,0]+cm_case[1,1]\) if \(cm_case[1,0]+cm_case[1,1]\)>0 else 0
        spec_case = cm_case[0,0]/\(cm_case[0,0]+cm_case[0,1]\) if \(cm_case[0,0]+cm_case[0,1]\)>0 else 0
        print\(f''    Sensitivity={sens_case:.4f}, Specificity={spec_case:.4f}''\)
        print\(f''    dSensitivity={sens_case-sens_img:+.4f}, dSpecificity={spec_case-spec_img:+.4f}''\)
        
        # Analyze positive cases - what % of images predicted positive?
        pos_cases = [\(vid, tr, pr, v, n\) for vid, tr, pr, v, n in case_pred_distribution if tr == 1]
        if pos_cases:
            pos_ratios = [pr for _, _, pr, _, _ in pos_cases]

                for vid, pr, n in fn_cases:
                    print\(f''      {vid}: pos_ratio={pr:.3f} \(n_images={n}\)''\)
")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix, accuracy_score, cohen_kappa_score, f1_score
from collections import Counter

task_classes = {
    ''zone'': {0: ''Zone I'', 1: ''Zone II'', 2: ''Zone III''},
    ''stage'': {0: ''Stage 0'', 1: ''Stage 1'', 2: ''Stage 2'', 3: ''Stage 3''},
}

for cond in [''good_only'', ''good_fair'']:
    pred_df = pd.read_csv\(f''ROP_project/multicenter_study/outputs_quality_comparison/{cond}/predictions.csv''\)
    
    print\(f''\\n{chr\(61\) * 75}''\)
    print\(f''  {cond.upper\(\)}''\)
    print\(f''{chr\(61\) * 75}''\)
    
    for task, class_map in task_classes.items\(\):
        label_col = f''{task}_label''
        pred_col = f''{task}_pred''
        classes = sorted\(class_map.keys\(\)\)
        cnames = [class_map[c] for c in classes]
        
        # --- Image-level ---
        y_true_img = pred_df[label_col].values.astype\(int\)
        y_pred_img = pred_df[pred_col].values.astype\(int\)
        mask = y_true_img >= 0
        y_true_img, y_pred_img = y_true_img[mask], y_pred_img[mask]
        
        acc_img = accuracy_score\(y_true_img, y_pred_img\)
        kappa_img = cohen_kappa_score\(y_true_img, y_pred_img, weights=''quadratic''\)
        f1_img = f1_score\(y_true_img, y_pred_img, average=''macro'', zero_division=0\)
        cm_img = confusion_matrix\(y_true_img, y_pred_img, labels=classes\)
        
        # --- Case-level \(majority vote\) ---
        case_true, case_pred = [], []
        for vid, grp in pred_df.groupby\(''video_id''\):
            y_t = grp[label_col].values.astype\(int\)
            y_p = grp[pred_col].values.astype\(int\)
            m = y_t >= 0
            y_t, y_p = y_t[m], y_p[m]
            if len\(y_t\) == 0: continue
            case_true.append\(int\(y_t[0]\)\)
            case_pred.append\(int\(Counter\(y_p\).most_common\(1\)[0][0]\)\)
        
        case_true = np.array\(case_true\)
        case_pred = np.array\(case_pred\)
        
        acc_case = accuracy_score\(case_true, case_pred\)
        kappa_case = cohen_kappa_score\(case_true, case_pred, weights=''quadratic''\)
        f1_case = f1_score\(case_true, case_pred, average=''macro'', zero_division=0\)
        cm_case = confusion_matrix\(case_true, case_pred, labels=classes\)
        
        print\(f''\\n  {chr\(45\) * 65}''\)
        print\(f''  {task.upper\(\)}''\)
        print\(f''  {chr\(45\) * 65}''\)
        print\(f''  Overall:  Image-level  Acc={acc_img:.4f}  Kappa={kappa_img:.4f}  F1={f1_img:.4f}''\)
        print\(f''            Case-level   Acc={acc_case:.4f}  Kappa={kappa_case:.4f}  F1={f1_case:.4f}''\)
        print\(f''            Diff         Acc={acc_case-acc_img:+.4f}  Kappa={kappa_case-kappa_img:+.4f}  F1={f1_case-f1_img:+.4f}''\)
        
        # Per-class comparison
        print\(f''\\n  Per-class Sensitivity \(Recall\):''\)
        print\(f''  {""Class"":>12s} {""n\(img\)"":>8s} {""n\(case\)"":>8s} {""Img-Sens"":>10s} {""Case-Sens"":>10s} {""Diff"":>8s}''\)
        print\(f''  {chr\(45\) * 60}''\)
        for i, cls in enumerate\(classes\):
            n_img = cm_img[i, :].sum\(\)
            n_case = cm_case[i, :].sum\(\)
            sens_img = cm_img[i, i] / n_img if n_img > 0 else 0
            sens_case = cm_case[i, i] / n_case if n_case > 0 else 0
            diff = sens_case - sens_img
            print\(f''  {cnames[i]:>12s} {n_img:>8d} {n_case:>8d} {sens_img:>10.4f} {sens_case:>10.4f} {diff:>+8.4f}''\)
        
        # Per-class PPV
        print\(f''\\n  Per-class PPV \(Precision\):''\)
        print\(f''  {""Class"":>12s} {""Img-PPV"":>10s} {""Case-PPV"":>10s} {""Diff"":>8s}''\)
        print\(f''  {chr\(45\) * 40}''\)
        for i, cls in enumerate\(classes\):
            ppv_img = cm_img[i, i] / cm_img[:, i].sum\(\) if cm_img[:, i].sum\(\) > 0 else 0
            ppv_case = cm_case[i, i] / cm_case[:, i].sum\(\) if cm_case[:, i].sum\(\) > 0 else 0
            diff = ppv_case - ppv_img
            print\(f''  {cnames[i]:>12s} {ppv_img:>10.4f} {ppv_case:>10.4f} {diff:>+8.4f}''\)
        
        # Confusion matrices
        print\(f''\\n  Confusion Matrix \(Image-level, n={len\(y_true_img\)}\):''\)
        header = ''  '' + '' '' * 12 + ''''.join\(f''{n:>10s}'' for n in cnames\) + ''   <- Predicted''
        print\(header\)
        for i, cn in enumerate\(cnames\):
            row = ''  '' + f''{cn:>12s}'' + ''''.join\(f''{cm_img[i,j]:>10d}'' for j in range\(len\(classes\)\)\)
            print\(row\)
        
        print\(f''\\n  Confusion Matrix \(Case-level, n={len\(case_true\)}\):''\)
        print\(header\)
